newsitem.title: UK: Daimler prices convertible notes issue.
newsitem.headline: Daimler prices convertible notes issue.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG has priced its offering of mandatorily convertible five-year 5.75 percent notes, joint lead managers Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Goldman Sachs International said.
The price for existing shareholders was 130.7 marks per note and for new investors 139.5 marks per note.
There are 7.6 million notes, due June 14, 2002, of which 3,942,652 were allocated to new investors, subject to a 40 percent clawback to be finalised on May 14.
Each note will be converted into one share at maturity at a maximum conversion price of 151.62 marks (16 percent premium to 130.7) and a minimum 104.56 marks (20 percent discount).
The offering will be listed in Frankfurt, Stuttgart and New York. The 5.75 percent coupon will be paid semi-annually in May and November.
